proof:
classical
intro N inst w E bases final es
induction es generalizing bases final with
| nil =>
    intro h
    unfold M7.GenerationReplay.replay at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hz
      have heq : bases = final := Option.some.inj h
      subst final
      exact ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    · simp at h
| cons e es ih =>
    intro h
    unfold M7.GenerationReplay.replay at h
    split at h
    · exact ih (insert e.representative bases) final h
    · simp at h
